d: A muscular reptilian creature with a mature, stern expression, featuring brown skin with darker brown leopard-like spots and a pale grey underbelly. It wears a golden helmet with teal accents, a gold and teal bracer on the right wrist, a gold wrist cuff on the left, and a grey fabric shawl draped over the shoulders. The creature holds a large black hammer with a teal crystalline head and possesses a long brown tail. BODY COLOR: Brown LEGS: Plantigrade with thick, three-toed grey feet.
